quranTranslation.text: And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!

explanation.bs: „I zasuli smo ih kišom – pa pogledaj kako su završili zločinci.“
explanation.en: “And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!”

quranTranslation.text: And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

explanation.bs: „A ružna je kiša onih koji su bili opomenuti.“
explanation.en: “Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.”

quranTranslation.text: And when thou (O Muhammad) art among them and arrangest (their) worship for them, let only a party of them stand with thee (to worship) and let them take their arms. Then when they have performed their prostrations let them fall to the rear and let another party come that hath not worshipped and let them worship with thee, and let them take their precaution and their arms. Those who disbelieve long for you to neglect your arms and your baggage that they may attack you once for all. It is no sin for you to lay aside your arms, if rain impedeth you or ye are sick. But take your precaution. Lo! Allah prepareth for the disbelievers shameful punishment.

explanation.bs: Nema smetnje da ostavite oružje ako vam kiša smeta – obična kiša.
explanation.en: No blame if you put down your arms when hindered by rain — ordinary rain.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy. He is the Protecting Friend, the Praiseworthy.

explanation.bs: On spušta kišu nakon što su izgubili nadu.
explanation.en: He sends down the rain after they had despaired.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah! With Him is knowledge of the Hour. He sendeth down the rain, and knoweth that which is in the wombs. No soul knoweth what it will earn to-morrow, and no soul knoweth in what land it will die. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

explanation.bs: Kod Allaha je znanje o Času, i On spušta kišu.
explanation.en: With Allah is knowledge of the Hour, and He sends down the rain.

quranTranslation.text: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.

explanation.bs: Kao kiša čije bilje oduševi sijače, pa se osuši – slika ovog svijeta; tefsir se razilazi: الْكُفَّار su ovdje sijači, ili nevjernici.
explanation.en: Like a rain whose growth pleases the tillers, then it dries — the likeness of this world; tafsir differs: الْكُفَّار here are tillers, or unbelievers.

quranTranslation.text: Ask the township where we were, and the caravan with which we travelled hither. Lo! we speak the truth.

explanation.bs: „Upitaj naselje gdje smo boravili“ – قَرْيَة za stanovnike.
explanation.en: “Ask the township where we were” — قَرْيَة for its people.

quranTranslation.text: And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper!

explanation.bs: „Tvoje naselje koje te je istjeralo“ – Meka nazvana قَرْيَة.
explanation.en: “Thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out” — Mecca called قَرْيَة.

quranTranslation.text: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.

explanation.bs: Došli su stanovnicima jednog naselja (قَرْيَة)… – isto mjesto (tako ga razumije većina mufesira) u 18:82 zove se مَدِينَة (grad).
explanation.en: They came to the people of a town (قَرْيَة)… — the same place (as most mufassirun take it) is called مَدِينَة (city) in 18:82.

quranTranslation.text: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not.

explanation.bs: „Ako se vratimo u Medinu…“ – مَدِينَة kao ime Poslanikovog grada.
explanation.en: “If we return to Al-Madinah…” — مَدِينَة as the name of the Prophet's city.

quranTranslation.text: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.

explanation.bs: Zid je pripadao dvojici dječaka siročadi „u gradu” – isto mjesto koje je u 18:77 قَرْيَة.
explanation.en: The wall belonged to two orphan boys “in the city” — the place that is قَرْيَة in 18:77.

quranTranslation.text: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!

explanation.bs: S kraja grada dotrča jedan čovjek – mjesto koje tefsir uzima kao قَرْيَة iz 36:13.
explanation.en: “There came from the uttermost part of the city a man running” — the place tafsir takes as the قَرْيَة of 36:13.

quranTranslation.text: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „I Koji me hrani i poji“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Abraham: “And Who feedeth me and watereth me” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to give to drink, to water

quranTranslation.text: So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.

explanation.bs: „Pa im on napoji stado, a zatim se skloni u hlad“ – Musa, pojedinačno djelo.
explanation.en: “So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade” — Moses, a single act.

gloss.en: to give to drink, to water

quranTranslation.text: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.

explanation.bs: „I njihov Gospodar napojio ih je čistim pićem“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za sakā.
explanation.en: “Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for saqā.

gloss.en: to give to drink, to water

quranTranslation.text: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.

explanation.bs: „…pa smo s neba spustili vodu i dali vam je za piće, a niste vi njeni čuvari“ – ar-Rāġib: učinili smo je izvorom vašeg pića.
explanation.en: “And cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof” — ar-Rāġib: We made it a supply of drink for you.

gloss.bs: dati vode za piće, opskrbiti pićem

quranTranslation.text: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

explanation.bs: „I na njoj smo postavili visoka, čvrsto usađena brda i slatkom vas vodom opskrbili“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: dati vode za piće, opskrbiti pićem

quranTranslation.text: And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers.

explanation.bs: „Opskrbljujemo vas pićem od onoga što je u njihovim utrobama“ – mlijeko stoke; ar-Rāġib, navodeći iste riječi iz 23:21, bilježi i čitanje nasqīkum (I vrsta).
explanation.en: “We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies” — the milk of cattle; ar-Rāġib, quoting the same words from 23:21, notes the reading nasqīkum (Form I).

gloss.bs: dati vode za piće, opskrbiti pićem

quranTranslation.text: Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible. So observe your duty to Allah in order that ye may be thankful.

explanation.bs: „Allah vam je već dao pobjedu na Bedru, kad ste bili slabi …“ – pomoć protiv neprijatelja, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible” — help against an enemy, as befits Him.

gloss.en: to help to victory, to give victory

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm.

explanation.bs: „O vjernici, ako vi pomognete Allaha, On će pomoći vas i učvrstiti vaše korake“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: rob ‚pomaže Allaha‘ pokornošću i pomaganjem Njegovih robova.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: the servant ‘helps Allah’ by obedience and by helping His servants.

gloss.en: to help to victory, to give victory

quranTranslation.text: When thou didst say unto the believers: Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should support you with three thousand angels sent down (to your help)?

explanation.bs: „… zar vam nije dovoljno da vas vaš Gospodar pojača s tri hiljade spuštenih meleka?“ – pojačanje dotokom, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “… Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should support you with three thousand angels sent down (to your help)?” — reinforcement by a supply, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

explanation.bs: „I opskrbit ćemo ih voćem i mesom, kakvo god požele“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet među primjerima, odmah nakon što kaže da je imdād najčešće u onome što je drago.
explanation.en: “And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah among his examples, right after saying imdād is mostly in what is welcome.

quranTranslation.text: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

explanation.bs: „Zar misle da im imetkom i sinovima kojima ih opskrbljujemo …“ – ar-Rāġib i ovaj ajet navodi u istom nizu primjera; nastavak (23:56) kaže da to nije žurba u dobru – tako da opskrba nije uvijek znak naklonosti.
explanation.en: “Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah too in the same list; the next ayah (23:56) says it is not a hastening of good — so a supply is not always a sign of favour.

quranTranslation.text: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.

explanation.bs: „… pa potpomozite me snagom, napravit ću između vas i njih bedem“ – Zul-Karnejn traži od ljudi radnu snagu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Dhul-Qarnayn asks the people to aid him with strength, so that he may set a barrier between them and Gog and Magog — labour, not victory; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: stati uz nekoga u poslu, biti mu na ruku

quranTranslation.text: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici tvrde da je Kur'an izmišljotina i da su mu u tome pomogli drugi ljudi – Kur'an tu tvrdnju odbacuje kao nepravdu i laž; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The disbelievers claim the Quran is an invention and that other folk aided him in it — the Quran rejects the claim as wrong and falsehood; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.bs: stati uz nekoga u poslu, biti mu na ruku

quranTranslation.text: And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided,

explanation.bs: „Svi zajedno se držite Allahova užeta i ne razdvajajte se …“ – razdvajanje je suprotno držanju zajedno.
explanation.en: “And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate” — splitting apart is the opposite of holding together.

quranTranslation.text: But if they separate, Allah will compensate each out of His abundance. Allah is ever All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

explanation.bs: „Ako se pak njih dvoje razdvoje, Allah će iz Svoje širine svakom od njih biti dovoljan …“ – tjelesno razdvajanje: muž i žena se rastaju; Allahova opskrba kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “But if they separate, Allah will compensate each out of His abundance” — bodily separation: husband and wife part; Allah's provision as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: And be ye not as those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs had come unto them. For such there is an awful doom,

explanation.bs: „Nemojte biti poput onih koji su se, pošto su im stigli jasni dokazi, razdvojili i razišli u mišljenju …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; razdvajanje i razilaženje idu jedno uz drugo.
explanation.en: “And be ye not as those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs had come unto them” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; splitting apart and differing go together.

quranTranslation.text: Mankind were but one community; then they differed; and had it not been for a word that had already gone forth from thy Lord it had been judged between them in respect of that wherein they differ.

explanation.bs: „Ljudi nisu bili ništa drugo do jedan ummet, pa su se razišli …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi; presuda o onome u čemu se razilaze ostavljena je Allahu, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Mankind were but one community; then they differed” — ar-Rāġib cites these words; the judgement on what they differ in is left to Allah, as befits Him.
